checks: All four tyres throw surface-appropriate debris and leave loose-ground tracks; asphalt produces none
Detached wheels stop emission, pools remain bounded, every instance transform is finite, reset and disposal clear all active effects
Stationary tyres do not emit; stationary wheelspin does, and airborne contacts do not create debris or teleport tracks
Forward and reverse stationary wheelspin launch both earth and grass in opposite directions at two car headings
Debris crossing raised and lowered surfaces lands at the sampled height with at most one sample per active particle per frame
Absent or invalid samplers retain finite fallback landings; the FX API keeps its sampler across resets and vehicle changes
Track planes follow uphill and downhill contact endpoints at three headings without flipping their visible face
limits: Three.js instance matrices and contact-driven effect math in Node, without a GPU render.
